title: Lean-Verified Disproof of the Caiolo–Ferroni–Hoster Dual Chow Conjecture for Matroids
whyItMatters: High-school senior Cinna Davis used GPT-6.2 Astra and Claude Opus 5.5 to disprove Caiolo–Ferroni–Hoster’s matroid dual Chow real-rootedness conjecture—verified in Lean 4 and posted directly to X & GitHub.
summary: Posted directly on X and GitHub rather than waiting for journal publication, Illinois Mathematics and Science Academy senior Cinna Davis (@1337isnot1337)—working with GPT-6.2 Astra and Claude Opus 5.5—disproved Conjecture 7.3 of Caiolo–Ferroni–Hoster (arXiv:2605.28474). By constructing an explicit family of simple rank-5 matroids via hyperplane coalescence for every prime power q ≥ 17, the proof shows the dual Chow quartic has no real roots and establishes the sharp rank threshold r ≤ 4, completely verified in Lean 4.35.0 and SymPy.
technicalHighlights: Constructed an infinite family of simple rank-5 matroids (prime powers q ≥ 17) whose dual Chow polynomial is strictly positive on ℝ (zero real roots) and whose dual right augmented polynomial fails real-rootedness.
Proved the exact sharp rank threshold: dual Chow real-rootedness holds for all matroids of rank r if and only if r ≤ 4.
Fully formalized in Lean 4.35.0 with Mathlib matroids plus an independent exact SymPy certificate, published openly on GitHub and X.
caveats: Unrefereed open-internet release (X + GitHub); internally audited with Lean 4 and SymPy replay scripts, while independent matroid-theorist journal review and priority checks remain open.

scoreRationale.foundational: Cleanly disproved an active research conjecture in matroid Hodge/Chow theory and pinned down the exact sharp rank boundary r = 4 vs. 5.
scoreRationale.ripple: Powerful emblem of the late-2026 shift: a high-school researcher with consumer AI + Lean can settle active arXiv conjectures and publish directly on X & GitHub.
scoreRationale.verification: Complete Lean 4.35.0 formalization of the finite Mathlib matroid family plus reproducible exact SymPy verification scripts; unrefereed.
scoreRationale.velocity: Refuted a May 2026 research conjecture with full Lean verification and sharp rank classification within days of targeting it.
